findings.title: Vulnerable dependency: simple-git
findings.description: simple-git 3.35.2: simple-git is vulnerable to Remote Code Execution. Affected range (simple-git): <3.36.0. GHSA-hffm-xvc3-vprc — https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-hffm-xvc3-vprc.
findings.attackScenario: An attacker could exploit the reported dependency vulnerabilities affecting simple-git.
findings.suggestedFix: npm proposes updating simple-git to 3.36.0. Upstream patch available for simple-git (GHSA-hffm-xvc3-vprc): 3.36.0.
